request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Change her colours only: her face and hands become pale cream skin, colour #f3dccb, with rosy cheeks; her hair becomes long straight white hair; remove the pointed blue hat so the ice crown sits on her white hair; the brown staff, belt and boots become pale ivory bone #eadfc8 and dark navy #1b2552. Keep the navy robe, the ice crown, the ice crystal on the staff, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
